verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only single-machine multi-GPU options: A100 machines with up to 8 GPUs and NVLink within a node. Separate machines can share a private network and shared drives, but that is a user-side arrangement, not a documented multi-node cluster with a fast inter-node interconnect for distributed training. High-end H100 machines also require an approval request, which works against the self-serve part of the story.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can provision a multi-node GPU cluster with fast interconnect for distributed training without a sales cycle
